title: The Golden Retrievers Who Turned Grief Into Friendship - NewsBreak
text: 14 hours ago One dog lost her lifelong companion, and another feared the world around her. Their unexpected friendship changed both of their lives. Whether they’re racing across the dog park, waiting together at the front door or curled up side by side, Lilly and Poppy rarely spend a moment apart. Their friendship looks effortless today. But not long ago, one dog was grieving the loss of her lifelong companion, while the other was too frightened to embrace the world around her. Together, they found exactly what the other was missing.
